title: Annie Hall Cudlip
dates: (1836-1918)
---

novelist

Well-known for her rather risky fiction, she married (1867) the Rev.

Pender Hodge Cudlip (1835-1911) curate of Yealmpton, near Puslinch, but CMY did not feel her fiction was sufficiently reformed by her marriage.
